name: Bantuan.Sarawak.News
title: Sarawak government assistance, in one directory.
description: An independent directory of Sarawak state assistance. Amounts come from official pages checked on 4 October 2026, and each scheme links to its source.
about_description: Bantuan Sarawak is an independent directory. It links only to official pages and lists amounts checked on 4 October 2026. The government does not run this site.
introduction: A directory of state help for people in Sarawak.

groups.title: Household
groups.intro: SKAS is the 2026 basic-needs payment. The electricity discount and the rental discount were announced with it. They are separate measures, not part of the SKAS food payment.

groups.title: Students
groups.intro: State education aid published by Yayasan Sarawak and MEITD. Sign in at my-Yayasan with Sarawak Pass. Phase 1 in 2026 ran from 31 March to 30 April. Phase 2, for special financial assistance, the laptop and the book voucher, runs from 30 September to 30 October 2026. It was open on my-Yayasan at this check.

groups.title: Housing
groups.intro: State schemes are published by the Housing Development Corporation and UKAS. The HDRAS monthly repayment is not stated on the official HDC page, so no repayment figure is shown.

groups.title: Health and seniors
groups.intro: State schemes for older residents: outpatient treatment, the Kenyalang Gold Card, and a payment to the family of a card holder who has died.

groups.title: New baby
groups.intro: Two state schemes around a birth. From 2026, the endowment fund application is online only.

groups.title: Welfare
groups.intro: Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat Sarawak handles Bantuan Am and Bantuan Belia-Beliawanis at district offices. The JKMS page, updated 9 September 2026, lists a state-aid poverty line (PGK) of RM1,198 a month. Apply at the nearest Pejabat Kebajikan Masyarakat with form JKMS/1/2010 (Pindaan 1/2024). The stated process time is 30 days. Phone 082-374888. Email welfare@sarawak.gov.my.

about_sections.title: What this site is
paragraphs: Bantuan Sarawak is an independent directory of government assistance for people in Sarawak. It is a list of schemes, not a news feed. The Sarawak government does not run this website, and neither does any ministry.
This site does not take applications. Each scheme links to the official page that was checked.

about_sections.title: Where the figures come from
paragraphs: Amounts are taken from official pages checked on 4 October 2026. If a ringgit figure was not on an official page, it is not shown.
Some JKMS rates appear only on a rate-sheet attachment, not on the main HTML page. Those cards are marked “On an attachment”.

about_sections.title: State schemes
paragraphs: Every scheme in this directory is a Sarawak state programme and is marked State.

about_sections.title: What is left out
paragraphs: A scheme name or a payment that was not confirmed on an official page in this check is left out. The HDRAS monthly repayment is one of those figures. UKAS describes the scheme. The repayment amount is not on the official HDC page.
The Service Sarawak SKAS page still shows older rates. This directory uses the UKAS rates of 16 April 2026: RM1,100, RM600 and RM375.
